title: A little cheap feeling.
text: A little cheap feeling.. There’s nothing necessarily wrong with this tray. It’s just looks a little cheap. The entire tray is plastic and lightweight, the metal U-shaped handle is very lightweight also. Hardware is included to screw the handle in from the base. It’s just nothing special. It is a tiny footprint, so that’s nice.
